catalyst.name: Target Lock Refit, One for All Refit, Hatchling Refit, High-Impact Reserves Refit
catalyst.description:
Grants the Target Lock trait:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [10.46%] to 40% [25%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.
Grants the One For All trait:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
Grants the Hatchling trait:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a Threadling at the target's location.
Grants the High-Impact Reserves trait:
Increases damage by 12.1% [3%] to 25.6% [6%] as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty.
The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

catalyst.name: Target Lock, Deterministic Chaos Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.
Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.
% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%
Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [10.46%] to 40% [25%] upon reaching maximum strength.
Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

catalyst.name: Collective Action, Devil's Ruin Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 30% [10%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.
Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. Firesprites and Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.
Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.
Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, or Void Breaches
Does not trigger with Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.

catalyst.name: Heirloom Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Scorch and Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 5% increased damage.
Direct Hits with Charged Shots apply 20|40|60 Scorch Stacks at Charge Level 1|2|3. Scorch application is unaffected by Ember of Ashes.
Grants 10% increased damage to Scorched enemies.
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

catalyst.name: Pressurized Refit, Frenzy Refit, 4-Timer Refit, Outlaw Refit
catalyst.description:
Grants the Under Pressure trait:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty:
• 12.5% to 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 0 to 30? Stability
Grants the Feeding Frenzy trait:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.
Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 8|50|60|75|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration
Grants the Fourth Time's The Charm trait:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.
Grants the Outlaw trait:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

catalyst.name: Skyburner Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants 20 Reload Speed.
Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.
Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more Scorch Stacks.
Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.
Direct Hits against Scorched Enemies apply 10 [4] additional Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [9?] with Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown.
Scoring 11 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.
Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.

catalyst.name: Stats for All Refit, Cascade Point Refit, Repulsor Brace Refit, Loose Change Refit
catalyst.description:
Grants the Stats For All trait:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 10 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
Grants the Cascade Point trait:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:
Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 2.5 seconds.
Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.
Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits
Grants the Repulsor Brace trait:
Kills against Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence).
Grants the Loose Change trait:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Buff can be activated while stowed.

Increases the Magazine Size by 3 (4🠚7) and grants 40 Ammo Generation.
Triggering Harbinger's Pulse three times will cause Telesto to start smoking and short circuiting, granting access to 'Harbinger's Seethe'.
Hold [Reload] to slap your malfunctioning Telesto. On its next direct hit, it will spawn a Wormhole from the Telesto Dimmension, wildly spraying 22 Telesto Bolts over 2.25 seconds.

catalyst.name: Jade Rabbit Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants 30 Stability.
Hold [Reload] to consume all Fate of All Fools stacks and load a Micro-Missile. Missile has a blast radius of 8 meters with a maximum damage falloff of 45%, and deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
Deals 293 damage (122 impact/171 explosive) [?] at base, becoming heavily weighted towards explosive damage as the stacks increase.
Damage is increased by 107%|157%|193%|223%|315%|345% at 2|3|4|5|10|15 Stacks, with a fully charged missile dealing 1304 (281 impact/1023 explosive) [?] damage.
Micro-Missile deals no self damage and can be used for rocket jumping.

catalyst.name: Killing Wind, Envious Assassin, The Last Word Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.
Loads 1 Ammo per kill achieved with other weapons.
Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.
On Weapon Kill, for 5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

catalyst.name: Rewind Rounds, The Queenbreaker Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants the Rewind Rounds trait:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.
Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.
Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.
Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).
Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

catalyst.name: Causality Quiver, Ticuu's Divination Catalyst
